p.s: Today, we can see a lot of people who are around us enjoy their life happily.
Some people go abroad and have good experience.
Other people go to the beach and relex.
However, I think, most of people who enjoy their life are order people.
In my opinion, young people do n't have many opportunities to enjoy their life.
Firstly, most young people have to study for their future.
They have to go to school and stay in school for half of the day.
So, they do n't have many chances to play around.
For instance, I am in grade 12 and go high school and so busy about doing a lot of homework and choosing an university for my future.
Although I have no time to enjoy my life, I went to Rocky Mountain with my friends.
However, the experience was not that greate because I had to keep thinking about school and university.
Morevoer, order people can enjoy their life more than young people because they have much time to enjoy.
Many order people quit their jobs and have enough money from the jobs to relex.
So, they can travel around the world for a long time rather than young people.
For instance, my homestay mom 's mother is staying in Canada for four months.
She can stay even for a year because my homestay mom provides food, money, and room for her.
Furthermore, young people usually do n't have enough money to enjoy their life.
Usually, young people get money from their parents.
Because of that reason, they may not have enough money to travel or enjoy.
In conclusion, order people enjoy their life more than young people because they may have much time to enjoy their life, and possess not much tasks to concern.
However, young people have to attend school, need to study all the time that they have, and get not enough money to enjoy.
So, young people do n't have many chances to enjoy their life.
Therefore, order people can enjoy their life more.
